cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while I practise telling the children about tomorrow's operation. Sit where they will sit, please. This needs to be a proper rehearsal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want me to ask whether you'll die?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not in that tone. Use their voices, please. I need to answer without snapping before I bring them in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can do one question. My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask that one again, quietly. Wait until I've answered without telling you how to ask it. Then I'll fetch the children.

reason: Replace tea-delay wrappers with A directing a rehearsal until able to face the children; B's actual time limit shapes the finite readiness test.
